summary: Dependabot bump of the monitoring Grafana image from 13.3.0 to 13.3.1 in monitoring/compose.yaml; only the tag and its digest change. The digest sha256:0615ec4fbd4072004b7d86b46ded63013a74b7d6eb1119273dd89e8fa25c13cf equals the current multi-arch index digest of grafana/grafana:13.3.1 on Docker Hub, so the reference stays immutable (ADR-0055). Compose bumps are outside the narrow Dependabot exemption of ADR-0050, hence this record. Read the v13.3.1 release notes (published 2026-11-10): six security fixes (CVE-2026-102589, -107509, -110992, -111024, -13721, -14242) plus small fixes (time zone data, provisioning of connection-backed repositories); a patch release with no configuration change for this stack (GF_SERVER_* TLS settings, admin password from a file secret, provisioning and dashboards read-only, user from GRAFANA_UID, loopback-free port as before). No new trust boundary, port, credential or network destination.

findings.evidence: A third-party container image is updated; a compromised release would run with the stack's Grafana admin secret and the router certificate.
findings.resolution: Pre-existing and unchanged in scope: the image stays pinned by digest (verified against the registry); release notes reviewed. The update itself closes six Grafana CVEs.

tests.command: Docker Hub registry HEAD /v2/grafana/grafana/manifests/13.3.1 (index media types)
tests.evidence: Docker-Content-Digest sha256:0615ec4fbd4072004b7d86b46ded63013a74b7d6eb1119273dd89e8fa25c13cf, identical to the pinned digest; tag pushed 2026-11-10T17:23Z.

limitations: The image was not started; monitoring/deploy_ct.py checks Grafana health when it rolls out.
13.3.1 was published on 2026-11-10; the operator's 7-day minimum image age is reached on 2026-11-17 - roll out from then on, or earlier only by the operator's decision for the security fixes.
